settings.heading: Honesty, printed on the label.
settings.text: Why we built AEONAE, one serum done properly, and the standard we refuse to lower.

settings.title: Disclosure, not adjectives
settings.text: The full ingredient list and the amounts that matter sit on the page. If we cannot state something honestly, the page stays quiet instead.

settings.title: One serum, done properly
settings.text: We would rather perfect a single formula we can stand behind than fill a shelf with products we cannot.

settings.title: Real people, straight answers
settings.text: Email a question and you will hear back from the people who made it, usually the same day.

settings.heading: We were tired of not knowing what was in the bottle.
settings.letter:
Tired of promises that sounded impressive and meant very little. Tired of paying for hope instead of honesty. When we could not find a brand that told us exactly what was inside, and exactly how much, we decided to build one ourselves.

Every ingredient printed in full. Every amount that matters, disclosed. If we cannot say something honestly, we do not say it at all. We are a small brand at the very beginning, and what we have is a standard we refuse to lower.

settings.label: Disclosure
settings.title: Nothing hidden behind a blend
settings.text: Every ingredient and the amounts that matter are printed on the product page, never buried in a proprietary blend or the fine print.
settings.why_text: You can read exactly what you are putting on your skin, and check it against anything you avoid, before you decide to buy.

settings.label: Claims
settings.title: Only what is true
settings.text: We describe how skin looks. We do not claim to treat, heal, or change anything we cannot stand behind.
settings.why_text: Honest language is the whole point. If we cannot say it plainly and truthfully, we would rather not say it at all.

settings.label: Sourcing
settings.title: Small, controlled batches
settings.text: Formulated and filled domestically in small runs, each one prepared with care rather than mass produced.
settings.why_text: Smaller batches mean tighter control and fresher product reaching your hands.

settings.label: Edition
settings.title: A First Edition of twelve
settings.text: One serum, done properly, before we ever add a second. Our First Edition is a run of twelve bottles.
settings.why_text: When the edition sells out it moves to a waitlist, so what you receive is always current.

settings.heading: A standard we refuse to lower.
settings.text: The questions a serum should answer before you ever put it on your skin, answered in the open.

settings.heading: A serum with nothing to hide.
settings.text: Every ingredient and the amounts that matter, printed in the open.
